relationships.subject: NLRP3
relationships.evidence_quote: inflammasome which activates caspase 1 (CASP1) through caspase recruitment domains (CARD)

relationships.subject: Caspase-1
relationships.evidence_quote: CASP1 enhances the biological activity of several pro-inflammatory cytokines, particularly Interleukin-1β (IL-1β) and Interleukin-18 (IL-18)

relationships.subject: NLRP3 rs35829419
relationships.evidence_quote: The high functioning allele of the rs35829419 SNP in NLRP3 was more common in those with severe Fatigue

relationships.subject: IL-1β rs4848306
relationships.evidence_quote: both the A allele of NLRP3 rs35829419 and the G allele of IL-1β rs4848306 were simultaneously associated with the severe Fatigue endophenotype

relationships.subject: NLRP3 rs35829419
relationships.evidence_quote: The A allele of NLRP3 rs35829419 is a missense mutation associated with an overactive NLRP3 inflammasome generating increased CASP1 activity and excessive IL-1β and IL-18 levels

key_findings: The A allele of NLRP3 rs35829419 was associated with severe fatigue in acute infection (EBV, RRV, Q fever; OR 13.3).
NLRP3 rs35829419 and IL-1β rs4848306 were independently associated with severe fatigue, implicating the NLRP3 inflammasome in the acute sickness response.
